title: Research: complete selected BIT residual traces with leaf children
body:
I connect the complete selected good/fallback adapter sequence to binary coefficient evaluation, serialized leaf programs and one shared stream trace. I retain later-pivot chronology, each fallback shear's intermediate permutation, physical orientation and the full adapter/child/inverse order. The trace carries symbolic coefficient references; each pass reads its own raw prefix.

I also implement binary cardinalities, radix-digit atom swaps and address signs. The packet interpreter visits all prefixes for each primitive and invokes each child once over the whole packet. I expand leaf children through ordinary atom swaps, three ADDs and a sign, with no weighted-swap oracle.

Evidence:

- Four actual selected COPY510/MOVE cases cover 640 address columns and 32,894 child invocations, including a two-column fallback, nonconstant generated ancestry and a later-pivot example over `Z/25`. I compare with the independent raw-projector operator.
- Complete good/fallback Boolean traces cover 26,244 bits each; another 2,916-bit test checks the unused middle. I check each output bit's source coordinate and erased scratch.
- A complete fixed-low GL2 high cube covers all 81 lifts and 531,441 bits through one shared child entry/return, with 2,430 fresh coefficient preparations. A two-header fallback packet keeps its nineteen child invocations shared across both headers.
- Eleven serialized-child evaluations, same-low coefficients `[0,6,3]`, chronology/orientation faults, source/child/layout rejections and 514 binary-cardinality cases check the remaining boundaries.

The written proof gives the scoped refinement and `C_q V(n+w)` local bill under the retained root coupling. I require child widths below 64. Larger recursive children, selected directory production, the full family/owner/global caller and formal machine verification remain open. I have not executed the selected GL64 Boolean payload or changed the selected exponent.

The registered Python 3.12 replay authenticates sources, checks the source suite and complete packet, then runs the adversarial suite with assertions disabled. I ran it locally with CPython 3.12.13 on macOS arm64. The optimized command covers the controls, not a second complete packet run. I claim no new Lean build or independent human review.

I started from canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. I refreshed main and live overlap; TASK.json records coverage and exact concurrent heads. I coordinated the scope in [Discussion2319](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18947427), following [Discussion2304's handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2304#discussioncomment-18947280).

NOTICE.md and SOURCES.json retain the source527, PR2159/2160/2188/2234/2310/2332/2364/2405/2449 lineage and the selected word/hosting contributors. I credit ywz65's separate PR2473 audit of unchanged PR2449 and PR2475 conditional whole-call staging, plus Ross Richardson's PR2448 routing result. I do not extend the PR2473 audit to this new implementation.

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematical analysis, implementation, checking and writing.
